    cmp_navy18_shipctrl_clear_owner_marks_effect = yes
    set_variable = { name = cmp_navy18_exact_ship_slot value = 82 }
    ordered_scope_ship = {
        limit = { hit_points > 0 }
        order_by = power_projection
        position = 81
        check_range_bounds = no
        set_variable = cmp_navy18_exact_ship_target
    }
    if = { limit = { any_scope_ship = { has_variable = cmp_navy18_exact_ship_target } } set_variable = { name = cmp_navy18_shipctrl_result value = 1 } }
}

cmp_navy18_shipctrl_set_flagship_effect = {
    every_scope_ship = {
        limit = { has_variable = cmp_navy18_exact_ship_target NOT = { is_in_battle = yes } NOT = { is_flagship = yes } OR = { is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_ship_of_the_line is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_early_ironclad is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_modern_ironclad is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_pre_dreadnought is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_dreadnought is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_super_dreadnought is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_frigate is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_iron_frigate is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_protected_cruiser is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_armored_cruiser is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_light_cruiser is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_seaplane_tender is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_aircraft_carrier is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_torpedo_boat_destroyer is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_destroyer is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_modern_destroyer is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_modern_cruiser is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_modern_battleship is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_nuclear_carrier } }
        set_as_flagship = yes
    }
    set_variable = { name = cmp_navy18_shipctrl_result value = 2 }
}
cmp_navy18_shipctrl_unset_flagship_effect = {
    every_scope_ship = {
        limit = { has_variable = cmp_navy18_exact_ship_target NOT = { is_in_battle = yes } is_flagship = yes }
        set_as_flagship = no
    }
    set_variable = { name = cmp_navy18_shipctrl_result value = 3 }
}
